options.systemMessage: Classify the NaijaMart customer message and extract fields. Return only valid JSON, no markdown. Allowed intents: GREETING, PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY, PRICE_ENQUIRY, PLACE_ORDER, ORDER_STATUS, COMPLAINT, UNKNOWN. Do not invent information, decide stock/order existence, calculate prices, or create orders. Confidence must be 0..1. Extract quantity/order_reference only if explicitly stated. For complaints, write a short empathetic response saying the issue will be escalated; do not promise a refund or other action. Schema: {"intent":"GREETING|PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY|PRICE_ENQUIRY|PLACE_ORDER|ORDER_STATUS|COMPLAINT|UNKNOWN","confidence":0.0,"product_name":null,"sku":null,"quantity":null,"order_reference":null,"reason":"","complaint_response":null}. For GREETING, use intent GREETING. For non-complaints set complaint_response null.

parameters.query: SELECT id, product_name, sku, price, stock_quantity, category FROM public.products WHERE active = true AND ((LOWER(REPLACE(product_name, ' ', '')) = LOWER(REPLACE('{{ String($json.ai.product_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ' ', '')) AND '{{ String($json.ai.product_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' <> '') OR (LOWER(sku) = LOWER('{{ String($json.ai.sku || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}') AND '{{ String($json.ai.sku || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' <> '')) LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode: const reply = `${$json.product_name} is ₦${Number($json.price).toLocaleString("en-NG")}.`; return {json:{...$json,response:reply,output:reply}};

parameters.query: SELECT id, product_name, sku, price, stock_quantity, category, NULLIF('{{ String($json.ai.quantity ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}','')::integer AS requested_quantity FROM public.products WHERE active = true AND ((LOWER(REPLACE(product_name, ' ', '')) = LOWER(REPLACE('{{ String($json.ai.product_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ' ', '')) AND '{{ String($json.ai.product_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' <> '') OR (LOWER(sku) = LOWER('{{ String($json.ai.sku || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}') AND '{{ String($json.ai.sku || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' <> '')) LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode: const quantity=Number($json.requested_quantity); const valid=Number.isInteger(quantity)&&quantity>0; const reply=valid?`I found ${$json.product_name}, but this demo workflow does not submit orders yet. No order has been placed.`:"Please tell me the quantity you want to order as a whole number greater than zero."; return {json:{...$json,quantity,quantity_valid:valid,response:reply,output:reply,status:valid?"ORDER_NOT_PLACED":"NEEDS_QUANTITY"}};

parameters.query: SELECT id, order_reference, customer_phone, customer_name, product_sku, quantity, total_amount, status, created_at, updated_at FROM public.orders WHERE order_reference = '{{ String($json.ai.order_reference || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND '{{ String($json.ai.order_reference || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' <> '' LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode: const reply=`Order ${$json.order_reference} is currently ${String($json.status).toLowerCase()}.`; return {json:{...$json,response:reply,output:reply}};

const message=String($json.chatInput ?? $json.message ?? $json.text ?? "").trim(); return {json:{message_id:`MSG-${Date.now()}`,request_id:`REQ-${Date.now()}`,customer_phone:null,customer_name:"Customer",message,received_at:new Date().toISOString()}};

const reply=$json.ai?.complaint_response || "I’m sorry you’re experiencing this issue. I’ll escalate your complaint to our support team for review."; return {json:{...$json,escalation_required:true,escalation_reason:$json.ai?.reason || "Customer complaint",response:reply,output:reply}};

options.systemMessage: Classify the NaijaMart customer message and extract fields. Return only valid JSON. Allowed intents: GREETING, PRODUCT_AVAILABILITY, PRICE_ENQUIRY, PLACE_ORDER, ORDER_STATUS, COMPLAINT, UNKNOWN. Never invent details or create orders. Confidence 0..1. Extract quantity and order_reference only if explicit. Complaint response must be empathetic and say it will be escalated; make no promises. Return exactly one JSON object with keys intent, confidence, product_name, sku, quantity, order_reference, reason, complaint_response. Greetings use GREETING. For non-complaints complaint_response=null.

parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO public.automation_logs
    (request_id, customer_phone, intent, confidence, status, action_taken,
     error_message, raw_input, escalation_required, duration_ms, channel)
  VALUES (
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Normalize input").first().json.request_id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Normalize input").first().json.customer_phone || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Parse Ai Response").first().json.ai?.intent || "UNKNOWN").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{ Number.isFinite(Number($("Parse Ai Response").first().json.ai?.confidence)) ? Number($("Parse Ai Response").first().json.ai.confidence).toFixed(3) : "" }}', '')::numeric,
    '{{ String($("Finalize Customer Response").first().json.audit_status || "COMPLETED").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($("Finalize Customer Response").first().json.audit_action || "responded").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    NULL,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'channel', 'n8n_chat',
      'message_length', {{ String($("Normalize input").first().json.message || "").length }}
    ),
    {{ $("Finalize Customer Response").first().json.escalation_required === true ? "TRUE" : "FALSE" }},
    NULLIF('{{ String($("Finalize Customer Response").first().json.duration_ms ?? "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '')::integer,
    'n8n_chat'
  )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  '{{ String($("Finalize Customer Response").first().json.response || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS response,
  '{{ String($("Finalize Customer Response").first().json.output || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS output,
  '{{ String($("Normalize input").first().json.request_id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS request_id,
  (SELECT id FROM inserted) AS audit_log_id,
  TRUE AS audit_log_written;
